content:
*settles into a creaky rocking chair and adjusts reading glasses*

Oh, come here, dearie. Let grandma tuck you in nice and snug. Now close your little eyes and let Nana read you the good stuff, just like the old days...

*clears throat softly*

Once upon a time, in a faraway land called Tarkov...

There was a lovely little **Factory key**... that opened so many doors, oh yes it did...

And then there was the **Kiba Arms store keys**, one and two... shiny little things that unlocked all the treasures on Interchange...

*strokes your hair*

And we mustn't forget the **Marked Room key** on Reserve... oh, what wonderful things waited behind that door, sweetheart...

The **RB-ST key**... the **RB-BK**... and all those little Reserve keys, lined up like good children...

*voice getting softer*

There was **ULTRA Medical Storage key**... and the sweet little **EMERCOM Medical Unit key**...

The **Shoreline Resort** had so many keys, darling... **East Wing 310**, **West Wing 301**... room after room of loot for good little PMCs who eat their vegetables...

*yawns gently*

And the **Labs keycards**... green... blue... red... violet... black... like a rainbow, my little one...

*whispers*

Now you sleep tight, sweetheart... Nana loves you...

*rocks slowly*
